_comment: Manual corrections on top of the OpenStreetMap extract. Applied by apply_fixes.py on every build.

drop_roads.100: No road 100 in Israel - an OSM tagging error on a 1 km local street in Shefa-Amr
drop_roads.109: No road 109 - 1 km stub at Eilot, tagging error
drop_roads.152: No road 152 - 0.3 km stub at Maoz Haim, tagging error
drop_roads.300: No road 300 - 0.4 km stub at Beit Hashmonai, tagging error
drop_roads.36: No road 36 - residential street in Salfit, tagging error

מחלף מבוא הכרמל._why: Road 22 km 4.15, where the Yigal Yadin road and its roundabout ramps meet road 22. The OSM build averaged several exit nodes into a point west of the interchange and wrongly picked up road 4 (which passes ~400 m away).

מחלף גשר פז._why: Road 4 km 162, HaHashmal St. bridge (Wikipedia junction list). Build placed the pin ~40 m east of road 4 and wrongly attached road 22 (~350 m away).
